related_questions.question: What does tongue cancer look like?

text_blocks.snippet: Tongue cancer can appear as a sore or ulcer on the tongue that doesn't heal, a lump or thickening on the tongue, or red or white patches on the tongue. It can also cause pain, bleeding, or numbness in the mouth or tongue, and difficulty with chewing, swallowing, or speaking.
snippet_highlighted_words: a sore or ulcer on the tongue that doesn't heal, a lump or thickening on the tongue, or red or white patches on the tongue

list.title: Sores or Ulcers:
list.snippet: A sore or ulcer on the tongue that doesn't heal after a few weeks is a common early sign. These may be painful or painless.

list.title: Lumps or Thickening:
list.snippet: A lump or thickening on the tongue, especially on the side where it touches the teeth, can be a sign.

list.title: Red or White Patches:
list.snippet: Red (erythroplakia) or white (leukoplakia) patches on the tongue or inside the mouth can be an early indicator.

list.title: Bleeding:
list.snippet: The sore or lump may bleed easily if bumped or bitten.

list.title: Pain or Numbness:
list.snippet: Pain or numbness in the tongue or mouth, especially if persistent, should be checked.
Difficulty swallowing or chewing: As the cancer grows, it can affect the tongue's ability to move, leading to difficulty swallowing or chewing.
Pain radiating to the ear: Pain may radiate to the ear on the same side as the affected tongue.
Swelling in the neck: Swollen lymph nodes in the neck can be a sign of cancer spread.
Voice changes: If the cancer affects the throat, it may cause changes in voice or speech.

list.title: Early detection is crucial:
list.snippet: If you notice any unusual changes on your tongue, it's important to see a dentist or doctor promptly.

list.title: Other conditions can cause similar symptoms:
list.snippet: Many other conditions can cause mouth sores or pain, but it's best to rule out cancer with a professional evaluation.

list.title: Regular dental checkups are recommended:
list.snippet: Dentists can often detect early signs of tongue cancer during routine oral exams.
